CheckTitle: Supabase Auth has anonymous sign-ins disabled
Description: **Supabase Auth** is assessed for **anonymous sign-ins**. Anonymous users are issued JWTs with the `authenticated` role, so every policy written for `authenticated` applies to them unless it also checks `is_anonymous`.
Risk: Policies that only check `auth.role() = 'authenticated'` silently **grant anonymous visitors the same data access as real users**, and anonymous accounts can be created in bulk to abuse quotas.

Code.Other:
1. Open the Supabase Dashboard and select the project
2. Go to Authentication > Sign In / Providers
3. Disable Allow anonymous sign-ins, or keep it on and add `(auth.jwt() ->> 'is_anonymous')::boolean is false` to sensitive policies

Recommendation.Text: Disable anonymous sign-ins unless the product needs them; when enabled, exclude anonymous users in row level security policies.
